assessmentStyles.demand: Content/theory understanding with a relevant explained example; no specified context in the exam prompt.
Apply biological/cognitive/sociocultural content to a supplied new situation in one named context.
Concept-based extended argument in a named context, connecting concepts and drawing a supported conclusion.
Methodological knowledge tied to the student’s own class practical.
Apply a psychological concept to the class practical.
Develop similarities AND differences between the practical method and another research method.
Explain a clear, accurate methodological procedure/design.
Discuss a supplied unseen experimental or non-experimental study through at least two concepts, chosen from at least four specified in the prompt.
Explain one issue limiting interpretation of a given graphic source.
Analyse given study findings in detail and state a conclusion explicitly linked to them.
Apply credibility, bias or transferability considerations to a supplied qualitative source.
Discuss validity of an explicit claim using at least three supplied sources and relevant own knowledge.

dataAnalysis.officialLevel: HL directly assessed; both levels study the material
dataAnalysis.authoringBoundary: Use supplied results/statistics for interpretation. Do not invent a requirement to perform a particular inferential test or calculator procedure that the accessed guide does not specify.
